svg.title: Load test plan
svg.desc: A repeating loop. The agreed test plan has persona tasks, test accounts and acceptance targets. The test system, a test tool and machines that create sessions, ramps up AVD sessions in stages. It runs against a representative host pool with the image, business applications and candidate VM. Sessions use shared dependencies such as profile storage, backends and the planned identity and network paths. Measurements collect task timings, errors and host and session metrics. The business owner reviews them, accepts or revises the configuration and records usable session density. Changes are retested.
svg.text: Simulation generates work; AVD Insights and Performance Monitor help explain the observed performance.
Confirm the load-test platform can generate the intended ramp and concurrent session count.
Personal desktop workloads need their own performance and recovery acceptance.
